messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: As of 2026-04-23, Priya has the Team Atlas pager for this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-04-23 to 2026-05-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-23]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-09, Marcus carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Priya. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to 2026-04-23; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-03, Priya carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Tomasz Nowak. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-03-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-09, Tomasz Nowak carries the Team Atlas pager for this cycle instead of Priya. [decision; valid 2025-05-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-09]

- In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya; Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune on 2025-07-02. [valid 2025-07-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-02]
    earlier: In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya and Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-02; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
